name: Graph Algorithms
description:
Introduction to Graphs: Definition and basic concepts, efficient representations of Graphs, revision of graph searching and different MST algorithms, Enumeration of all spanning trees of a graph. Graph Connectivity algorithms,
Hamiltonian Graphs: sufficient conditions for Hamiltonian graphs, checking Hamiltonicity: Bellman-Held-Karp Algorithm, Characterization of Eulerian graphs, The Chinese Postman problem, Traveling Salesman Problem,
Planar Graphs: properties of planar graphs, a planarity testing algorithms; Graph Coloring: vertex coloring, edge coloring, planar graph coloring; Matching: maximum matching in bipartite graphs, maximum matching in general graphs; Finding Perfect Matchings, NP-completeness of graph problems, Exact Exponential Algorithms for NP-complete graph problems, Approximation algorithms for some NP-Hard graph problems; Algorithms for some NP-Hard graph problems on special graph classes; Treewidth: Definition, Dynamic Programming on Bounded Treewidth Graphs, Approximating Treewidth.
